label: Hindi has no article: definiteness is carried by bareness, by ek, and by a demonstrative
note: HI-C86-koi-article states what the note said the corpus never stated: Hindi has no article, and a bare noun covers both a book and the book. It names the three things that carry specificity when it matters -- ek, vah, or nothing at all -- and makes the point the note asked for about ek chay dijiye, that ek is the numeral one doing indefiniteness work rather than a fixed cafe formula. The lesson ends on the habit rather than the fact: the commonest correct translation of English the is nothing.
